methodologicalNote: This screening records only conservative structural conclusions available before a dedicated reproducible cell-label dataset is persisted. It does not claim a machine-verified 3/7/12 segmentation and does not promote H-22.

observations.claim: The central rose is visually/compositionally distinct from the outer 72-fold annular domain and must retain an independent topology model.
SRC-0003 has a materially different central composition and is unsuitable as an independent cardinality confirmation for the SRC-0002 rose.
A 3 + 7 + 12 layered organization may exist in SRC-0002, but it remains a target hypothesis until cells and layers are independently segmented and counted.

h22.claim: central rose has independently observed layers/cells totaling 3 + 7 + 12 = 22
h22.reason: No complete persisted machine-generated cell-label map with threshold sensitivity and adjacency graph exists yet.

requiredForNextPromotion: Persist exact central ROI and calibration parameters.
Persist independently detected closed-region/cell candidates with centroids, areas and boundary confidence.
Run sensitivity analysis over declared segmentation thresholds/scales.
Build adjacency graph from stable cells only.
Infer layers from geometry before comparing layer counts with 3/7/12.
Record H-22 as SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, REFUTED or UNRESOLVED solely from that dataset.
